summary: CD 2017-CD6 Mortgage Trust filed an 8-K reporting that, effective October 2, 2026, Torchlight Loan Services, LLC replaced Argentic Services Company, L.P. as special servicer for the Colorado Center mortgage loan and related pari passu/subordinate notes, a non-serviced loan combination governed by the BXP 2017-CC trust and servicing agreement. Torchlight was appointed at the direction of Aperture Strategic Credit Master Fund, LP, controlling class representative. Servicing remains governed by the existing TSA. No deal terms, prices, or board recommendations are stated; this is a routine servicing-appointment disclosure, not a special situation.
